title: The Morning Digest: October 25, 2026
dek: Friday's settlement file landed after Saturday's edition. Dec26 synthetic crude settled at +$5.70 on 300 lots, its first traded settle since Oct 13, below both pre-registered return lines of +$7.00 and +$6.50, so the return verdict grades on the supply-return side. WCS Dec26 widened to -$28.50 on 555 lots the same day, putting December WCS outright at $74.77. The completed Friday diesel crack closed at $97.78, below $100 for the first time since the sustained run began on Aug 17. Saturday brought a fourth straight day of confirmed interceptions over Saudi Arabia and an unconfirmed claim against the air base at Khamis Mushait; the seven-vessel claim is silent for a fourth day. Ukraine claimed overnight strikes on the Ryazan and Novoshakhtinsk refineries.
